notes: Variant WLC.2CH.8.18.v002 is underdetermined with base reading retained; no fallback exclusion.

יוֹדְעֵי יָם → *that had knowledge of*: articleless attributive participle takes the relative (rule 41), light verb headed on *knowledge*, and the *of* the English verb phrase needs to reach its object joins the verb rather than the rectum (rules 19, 44); supplied *them* after *brought* is added (rule 44).
